checks.evidence: Stylized animated-feature 3D in all three with adult broad-shoulder build, enlarged expressive eyes without child-like oversized head, smooth matte skin without photographic pores or etched wrinkles, beard and moustache as coherent sculpted masses without individual stubble, no text, labels, captions or watermarks.

Quick normal pass over full image: normal limbs, natural joints, open empty hands with five digits where countable, complete legs and footwear; no fused, extra, missing or mangled fingers, extra or missing limbs, broken joints or melted faces; small back-view fingers show nothing wrong.

All three show exactly four equal-scale neutral standing figures ordered front, three-quarter, profile, back on one baseline with margins above hairstyle and below soles, heads hands legs and footwear uncropped, arms relaxed slightly away from torso, hands open and empty, rust-red knit continued over back, no props held.

All three show exactly eight head-and-shoulders portraits in two rows of four facing camera in prompt order neutral, warm smile, pure joy, thoughtful concentration, determined resolve, gentle surprise, tender concern, playful mischief with coordinated brows, eyelids, cheeks and mouth; Option 1 reads clearest, Options 0 and 2 remain readable and distinct.

checks.evidence: Option 1 holds rust-red sweater, silver chain necklace, hairstyle, beard, complexion and proportions across all twelve depictions with chain visible in turnarounds and portraits. Option 0 shows thin chain in top-row turnarounds but no chain in middle and bottom portraits. Option 2 shows thin chain in top-row turnarounds but essentially no chain in portrait rows. Options 0 and 2 are therefore not clean and are excluded from ranking; Option 1 is clean on every criterion so the set passes.
